title: 1. People need to see what links to what

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Links between records exist but cannot be seen: SRS shows the tool's model, not the shape of the work.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The owner, 2026-10-09: "I have found myself wanting to work by drawing boundaries, creating distinctions and then seeing relationships ... I'm looking for systems in systems" (srs-programme source-documents/srs-web-lenses-2026-10-09/assessment.md). The affirmed problem SP-48 says links between records are hidden. The lenses remedy (364126da, built as srs-web#547) answers with three panes: a set, one thing, and what links to it. The Map is the only picture, and at 704 records it is a dense circle with truncated labels (srs-web#481). In October the owner asked twice to see links: remedy relations (vignette 2941f51a) and which comment links to what (35e35dd2). The earliest request found is muDemocracy-decisions#21 (2026-03-17): mapping the conversation.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Where does a graph view live: a lens layout, a Composition, or a new presentation object? There are no usage numbers for the Map.
